choice_policy: One diagonal_mode is selected deterministically from the episode seed and reused for all demonstrations and the query.
invariant_reasoning: Extract the nonzero rectangle, use period height+width, stamp the rotated complementary-color companion first, then source-color same-orientation stamps, clipping at the canvas. Only the active diagonal sign family changes.
limitations: Only both, falling, and rising sign-family settings are studied.
Evidence covers one deterministic four-input episode per setting plus the four canonical labels.
Pairwise mode rivals are checked; undeclared rule families remain unproven.
The prototype is isolated and does not alter the selected production generator or authority.

diagonal_mode.input_constraint: Episodes use lawful nonzero rectangles on canvases where each mode produces a distinct result; inputs themselves do not encode the mode.
diagonal_mode.meaning: Which sign families are used when propagating primary and rotated stamps: both, falling (\), or rising (/).

scope: Proposed task-local extension only; not a canonical rule change, production axis, approval refresh, or training-admission claim.
